messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate and 502/429 spike observed for /v1/generate across hosted region-us-east-1. alert_id=inc-2015-qlt. auto-escalation to oncall.
AlexC: seeing 50% throttled responses from user-facing tenants, latency up ~2x. Dashboards show sudden jump at 15:12 UTC.
MariaG: confirmed. Canary traffic for rollout 'adaptive-throttle-v3' started at 15:10, looks correlated. Canary was supposed to be 1% but metric shows ~20% routing.
SanjayR: oh no — routing policy misconfigured in rollout config. The canary rule used the wrong tag (region->global). Rolling back routing now?
BethL: customer-impact check: CS queue shows multiple accounts reporting token-exhausted errors, some premium customers hitting quota. Escalating to support.
AlexC: priority mitigation: turn off new throttle policy flag 'adaptive-throttle-v3' via FF service. Can someone flip the flag?
OpsOncall: I'm on it. Running: ``curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"adaptive-throttle-v3","state":"off"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}'``
deploy-bot: deploy started: hotpatch/2026-03-15/disable-adaptive-throttle. CI checks passed. ETA ~90s.
MariaG: while deploy is in progress, enable a permissive exemption for known premium orgs: add token exemptions for orgs with metadata.exempt=true to bypass rate path. Command in redis-console: ``HMSET rate_exempt:org:12345 exempt_until 4102444800`` (example).
SanjayR: creating temporary rule: ``POST /admin/rules -d '{"match":"metadata.org.exempt==true","action":"bypass_rate"}'`` — applied. Confirmed on staging then to prod.
AlexC: seeing error rate drop in the dashboard midway through deploy. 429s down from 50% -> ~12%. Good.
OpsOncall: hotpatch finished and flag confirmed off. ``/flags/adaptive-throttle-v3 -> false``. Rolling back the canary routing to prior config, triggering safe-rollout revert.
SupportLiaison: notified impacted customers, queued credits for affected premium customers, and posted status update on status.redwood.ai: "Investigating: deploy caused surge throttling; mitigation applied; full rollback underway."
BethL: root-cause notes: rollout routing rule used tag 'global-canary' instead of 'us-east-canary' due to templating bug in rollout service. Secondary issue: token accounting mismatch in rate engine (token_shard_mismatch) amplified throttling for certain token shards.
SanjayR: filing follow-up: create bug tickets: TKT-7421 (rollout templating fix), TKT-7422 (token_shard_mismatch investigation), TKT-7423 (add canary-sanity traffic limits).
MariaG: postmortem owners: MariaG primary, SanjayR infra lead, AlexC mitigation lead. ETA for postmortem draft EOD tomorrow.
AlexC: lessons: add automated canary traffic assertions, and a fail-open for exemption logic. Also add an on-deploy smoke that verifies token accounting invariants.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation complete, impact reduced. Duration 00:28:41. Severity: Sev2.
BethL: thumbs up to everyone for quick coordination. :thumbsup:
SupportLiaison: I'll follow up with customers and include timeline and credits.
MariaG: will schedule an oncall debrief 16:30 UTC — invite sent.
